title: 第104章 酆都阴司第103章 香火成道
content_zh:
第104章酆都阴司
“宵小放肆！”
神像凛然而立，那张原本僵硬的蜡质面孔此刻彻底活了过来，五官因痛苦和愤怒拧成一团。
寄托在其中的神魂终于苏醒，一道夹杂着神魂威压的传音在废墟上空炸响。
“你是哪门弟子，居然敢来害我道果！”神像试图重新凝聚梵文抵挡血光，但语气中却是少了几分先前的空洞，“如果你停下所有手段退出去，待本座成道之后，自然会重谢于你。”
苏阎立在半空，听着这番话，顿时冷笑出声。
“前辈这话现在才说，不觉得晚了点吗？”
方才自己好声好气给台阶下，你这老东西装聋作哑，一口一个万死难赎。
现在察觉到天魔解体神光能彻底磨灭他这缕分魂感受到危机了，这才端起架子讲起好话来了？
真当他是那么好惹的？
“什么？”神像之中那道魂魄微微一愣，显然没料到这外来散修竟如此油盐不进。
但还没等神像再开口，只见苏阎双手结印。
嗡！
在他的身后，一尊百丈高的金色千手法相拔地而起。
千只巨手在虚空中层层叠叠地铺开，遮天蔽日。
天魔解体神光附着在这法相之中。
霎时间，金色褪去，取而代之的是一片浓烈的血红，千手法相被血光浸透，原本庄严肃穆的佛相变得狰狞可怖，如同从修罗地狱中走出的杀神。
“小辈你敢！”神像察觉到那股足以将他这缕分魂彻底抹杀的恐怖气机，发出歇斯底里的咆哮。
苏阎根本没有理会这无能狂怒。
他单臂抬起对准下方的神像，重重一握。

血色千手法相跟着动作，千只巨手在半空中迅速合拢，化作两只擎天血手，一左一右，将那尊巴掌大小的红蜡烛神像死死拍在掌心之中。
咔嚓！
刺耳的碎裂声从血手掌心传出。
青金色的梵文连半息都没能撑住，便在天魔解体神光的碾压下彻底崩碎。
那缕寄托在神像中的筑基真人分魂，连惨叫都没来得及发出，便被神光消解得干干净净。
苏阎松开手。
血色法相随之散去。
半空中，那尊受幽都修士顶礼膜拜的祖师神像，已然被捏得粉碎，化作漫天红色的蜡屑纷纷扬扬地洒下。
唯独剩下一道青金色的法光，静静地悬浮在半空。
大神通碎片道韵。
苏阎招了招手，那道青金法光受到牵引，落入他的掌心。
紧接着苏阎端详起这【太乙救苦度厄往生真诀】，“可惜了，这神像当中的神通道韵，虽然比之前从长生尸身上抽取的要强大许多，但总量依然算不上多。”
不过苏阎略一思索，便明白了其中的问题。
这神像不管怎么看都像是量产的制式法宝。
content_en:
Chapter 104 Fengdu Yinsi
"Xiao Xiao is so arrogant!"
The statue of the god stood majestically, and the originally stiff waxy face came to life completely at this moment, and the facial features were twisted into a ball with pain and anger.
The soul entrusted in it finally woke up, and a sound transmission mixed with the pressure of the soul exploded over the ruins.
"What kind of disciple are you? How dare you come to harm my Dao Fruit!" The statue tried to re-concentrate Sanskrit to resist the blood light, but the tone was a little less hollow than before. "If you stop all means and exit, I will naturally thank you again after I achieve enlightenment."
Su Yan stood in the air and sneered when he heard these words.
"Senior, you're just saying this now, don't you think it's a little late?"
Just now, you are so good and so angry that you are pretending to be deaf and dumb.
Now that he realizes that the divine light of the demon's disintegration can completely wipe out his split soul and feels the crisis, is he now putting on airs and saying good things?
Do you really think he is that easy to mess with?
"What?" The soul in the statue was slightly startled, obviously not expecting that this outsider cultivator would be so incompetent.
But before the statue could speak again, Su Yan formed a seal with his hands.
Buzz!
Behind him, a hundred-foot-tall golden Thousand Hands Technique rises from the ground.
Thousands of giant hands spread out layer upon layer in the void, covering the sky and the sun.
The demon disintegrates and the divine light is attached to this dharma image.
In an instant, the golden color faded away and was replaced by a strong blood red. The Thousand Hands Dharma Appearance was soaked in the blood light, and the originally solemn and solemn Buddha Appearance became ferocious and terrifying, like a murderous god coming out of the Asura Hell.
"Junior, how dare you!" The idol roared hysterically as it sensed the terrifying energy that could completely wipe out his soul.
Su Yan didn't pay attention to this incompetent rage.
He raised one arm, pointed it at the statue below, and gave it a heavy grip.
The bloody Thousand Hands Technique followed the movement, and the thousand giant hands quickly closed together in mid-air, turning into two bloody hands holding up the sky, one on the left and one on the right, slapping the palm-sized red candle statue in the palm of their hands.
Click!
A harsh cracking sound came from the palm of the bloody hand.
The green-gold Sanskrit text couldn't even hold on for half a breath before it completely collapsed under the crushing force of the divine light of disintegration of the demon.
The fragmented soul of the foundation-building master entrusted in the statue was completely dissolved by the divine light before he even had time to scream.
Su Yan let go of his hand.
The bloody appearance then dispersed.
In mid-air, the statue of the Patriarch, worshiped by the Youdu monks, had been crushed to pieces and turned into red wax chips that scattered all over the sky.
Only a green-gold Dharma light was left, floating quietly in the air.
The rhyme of fragments of great supernatural power.
Su Yan waved, and the green-gold magic light was drawn and fell into his palm.
Then Su Yan looked at this [Taiyi's True Secret to Saving Sufferers and Ending Their Rebirth], "It's a pity that although the divine path charm in this statue is much stronger than what was extracted from the immortal corpse before, the total amount is still not that much."
But after Su Yan thought about it for a while, he understood the problem.
No matter how you look at it, this statue looks like a mass-produced standard magic weapon.
